training: 6 independent generated CVRP size-50 instances per seed; same suite within the four arms
outer_controller: One Codex operator, Plan decisions restricted to own arm evidence, common ranking task, on arms use explicit mathematical hypotheses and analysis; off arms use performance feedback and direct code exploration
memory: Independent cold Markdown stores; write bounded evidence-bound entries only for novel actionable findings
sources: Unchanged evaluator, incumbent-only inheritance, provider thinking disabled and repair off
primary: Final mean training distance relative to nearest-neighbor on the same paired seed
secondary: Valid generated fraction, incumbents by round, delivered memory, request/solver cost, recorded Plan alignment and hypothesis disposition
causal_scope: Small factorial pilot; same outer controller and possibly differing prompt content; not a general estimate of model math ability
